completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-18-2018-CUSTOMS-AMENDMENT-ORDER-2018.pdf》（4 页），本次切分 3 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Customs (Amendment) Order, 2018.
Section 136 of the Customs Order, 2006, in this Order referred to as the principal Order, is amended, in subsection (11, by deleting "$1,000" from the last line and by substituting "$5,000" therefor.

Section 140 of the principal Order is amended -

(a) in subsection (1) -

(i) in sub-paragraph (i), by inserting "subject to sub-paragraph (ia)," immediately before "in" in the first line;

(ii) by inserting the following new sub-paragraph immediately after "(ia) in the case of uncustomed goods, such goods being dutiable goods consisting of wholly or partly of tobacco -

(A) for the first offence, to a fine of - [AA) not less than 8 times the amount of customs duty or $5,000, whichever is the greater amount; and (AB) not more than 15 times the amount of customs

(B) for a second or any subsequent conviction, to a fine of - (BA) not less than 20 times the amount of the customs (BB] not more than 30 times the amount of customs amount, imprisonment for a term not exceeding except that when the amount of customs duty cannot be ascertained, the penalty may amount to a fine not exceeding

(iii) in sub-paragraph (iii), by deleting "sub-paragraph (iv]" from the first line and by substituting "sub-paragraphs (iv] and (v)";

(iv) in sub-paragraph (iv)(B], by deleting the fullstop from the last line and by substituting a semicolon therefor;

(v) by adding the following new sub-paragraph - "(v] in the case of prohibited goods, such goods consisting of intoxicating liquor - (A] for the first offence, to a fine of - (AA) not less than 8 times the amount of customs (AB] not more than 15 times the amount of customs

(B) for a second or any subsequent conviction, to a fine of - (BA) not less than 20 times the amount of the customs (BB) not more than 30 times the amount of customs amount, imprisonment for a term not exceeding 3 years or both, except that when the amount of customs duty cannot be ascertained, the penalty may amount to a fine not exceeding

(b) by adding the following new subsection - "(3) In this section - "tobacco" has the meaning assigned to it in the Tobacco Order, 2005 (S 4912005) and includes -

(a) tobacco products; and

(b) any tobacco substitute which is capable of being "tobacco products" has the meaning assigned to it in the Tobacco Order, 2005 (S 4912005) .". Made this 8th. day of Rejab, 1439 Hijriah corresponding to the 26th. day of March, 2018 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM Dicetak oleh Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam.
